keyword.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60的区别

title.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both print 35 m³/h and 30 MPa. One is a 75 kW motor. The other is a 6105 diesel at 144 kW.
description.zh: 两边都印 35 m³/h 和 30 MPa。一台是 75 kW 电机，另一台是 6105 柴油机 144 kW。

h1.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric Low Pressure 60 and Diesel 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Both print 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, a 0.4 m³ hopper is only on Diesel 60 while Low Pressure 60 prints 0.5 m³, and both print 3500 kg. Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW and three stone rows. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW, model HBT60-13.132 and one distance pair, 150 m / 350 m.
directAnswer.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。两边都印 35 m³/h 和 30 MPa，重量都是 3500 kg。料斗并不相同：柴油60为 0.4 m³，低压60为 0.5 m³。低压60印 75 kW 和三行石子距离。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW、型号 HBT60-13.132，以及一组距离 150 m / 350 m。

heading.en: Where Electric Low Pressure 60 and Diesel 60 print different values
heading.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60哪些数值不同

body.en: Model line: Electric Low Pressure 60 prints Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60; Diesel 60 prints Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Hopper capacity: Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 0.5 m³; Diesel 60 prints 0.4 m³. Dimensions: Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Diesel 60 prints 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. The same printed value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 35 m³/h on both pages; Max. outlet pressure is 30 MPa on both pages; Hydraulic pump is Kawasaki double pump 100 on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 型号行：电动低压60印 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60；柴油60印 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。料斗容积：电动低压60印 0.5 m³；柴油60印 0.4 m³。外形尺寸：电动低压60印 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm；柴油60印 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 35 m³/h；最大出口压力两边都是 30 MPa；液压泵两边都是 Kawasaki double pump 100。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric Low Pressure 60 prints cells that Diesel 60 does not: Motor power 75 kW; Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. Diesel 60 prints cells that Electric Low Pressure 60 does not: Diesel engine power 6105 / 144 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动低压60有、柴油60没有的行：电机功率 75 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m。柴油60有、电动低压60没有的行：柴油机功率 6105 / 144 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Shared output and pressure still leave the power source and the distance layout different. Open /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 60 and /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 产量和压力相同，动力来源和距离写法仍然不同。看电动低压60请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/，看柴油60请打开 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 60 print the same model line as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60的型号行一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60. Diesel 60 prints Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压60印 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60。柴油60印 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 60 print the same hopper capacity as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 0.5 m³. Diesel 60 prints 0.4 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压60印 0.5 m³。柴油60印 0.4 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 60 print the same dimensions as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Diesel 60 prints 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压60印 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm。柴油60印 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 60?
question.zh: 为什么柴油60没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 60 page does not print that label. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油60这一页没有印这个标题。电动低压60印的是 75 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
